notes: Plan positions from fig. 529 (p. 616). The entry's map ref (Israel grid 2014 1798) equals the unit point, so I put the unit point at the centroid of the walled camp: the corners measured on the plan give sides of 57/103/72/117 m against the stated 56/104/72/116 m, which confirms the scale. North arrow points exactly to page-right (measured), taken as grid north. Scale bar 0-20 m = 133.5 px (6.68 px/m). Each 'Cis' symbol on the plan is one feature: 7 symbols (4 inside, 3 outside), although the data block says 'Cisterns: 6'. The text names two large cisterns in inner squares, more cisterns inside and outside, and one in the SW annex. Which symbols are the two inner-square cisterns is not certain, so a generic quote is used. s2f1 (323 deg) lies about 8 deg inside the C2 sector, so a shift of about 5 m in the assumed centre would move it onto the 315 deg edge. s2f5 is at 308 deg. The sarcophagus is coded as a grave because it is a burial container; the entry does not call it a tomb. The 15 m dam 0.3 km W in a wadi is not coded: it is not called a pool or reservoir and no basin is described. 'New Trench' is modern army damage. No absence statement.
